question: Which natural dye gave the highest spray-drying yield, and what moisture content does its powder have?
rendered:
According to the document, the natural dye that gave the highest spray-drying yield was Tingi, with a yield of 85.67%. 

The powder from Tingi also had the highest moisture content, which was 11.27% ± 0.07%.
